note: Fixed 2026-10-16 BEFORE any run with this profile. An assumption, not a measurement: the user has no exchange account (minor) and therefore no execution reports. Results under this profile are research-only and can never reach PAPER_TEST_READY; only a sealed cost_calibration VERIFIED record can. A change needs a new file (v2) with a reason.
fee_source: Binance USDT-M futures public fee schedule for the base (regular, no BNB discount) tier: maker 0.0200%, taker 0.0500%. Not fetched in this environment (Binance hosts are blocked); re-check against the exchange's published page before relying on it.
fee_basis: every fill assumed taker (the more expensive side), entry and exit
slippage_basis: conservative extra per side on top of the half spread for latency, queue and adverse selection; not estimated from data
